environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance with application database user 'configsvc_ro' configured via pg_hba.conf with hostssl entry and connection routed through RDS Proxy with IAM authentication. The database role has been provisioned with a restricted grant set: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO configsvc_ro; additionally DEFAULT PRIVILEGES are set so future tables also only grant SELECT. The role has NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT attributes. A separate pgaudit extension logs all attempted DML operations. Note: the application catches database exceptions in the /config/save endpoint and continues execution with in-memory state regardless of persistence outcome.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO configsvc_ro; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO configsvc_ro;
